description: 행정안전부_자전거길(사고지점) [cycling networks] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 행정안전부. 행정안전부에서 운영하는 생활안전지도 ( safemap. go. kr)에서 제공하는 자전거길 정보입니다. 전국의 국토 종주 자전거길, 지자체 명품 자전거길, 바다를 품은 섬 자전거길 등의 테마 별 자전거 길에 대한 정보를 수집하여 지도형태로 제공하고 있으며 openAPI를 통한 XML... The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
